notes.title: Whisker Wanderlust | Steam Next Fest June Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Get ready for the super adorable kitty adventure – see the world through a cat's eyes (ΦωΦ) Whisker Wanderlust is joining Steam Next Fest this June! Demo Release Time: June 10 (Beijing Time)

Demo Details:
[olist]
Free trial of Level 1

Unlock Level 2 by adding the game to your Wishlist!
[/olist]
Collect and find yarn balls within levels to progress the main story. Interact with NPCs to accept quests and help them find lost items.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603580/_/"][/dynamiclink]

Whisker Wanderlust is here! Help a mischievous cat who ruined its owner’s 376th yarn ball by collecting replacements. Embark on a leisurely journey to see the world through feline eyes, where reality blends with whimsical fantasy. Along the way, befriend quirky companions, lend them a paw, and ultimately find your way back home. May every cat in the world be loved ♥♥♥



Game Features:

10+ levels (including a secret stage!)

30+ interactive NPCs

1,200+ hidden items to discover

✦ Gameplay ✦
[olist]
Main Quest: Collect yarn balls in each scene to advance the story and unlock the ending.

Side Quests: Interact with NPCs to unlock quests and help them gather items.

Secret Stage: Collect cans in the main story to unlock "Postcard Mode." Find collars in postcard treasure chests to access the hidden stage (with a bonus storyline!).

Art & Easter Eggs: Explore vibrant hand-painted impasto art style and discover classic IP easter eggs!
[/olist][hr][/hr]
Studio’s New Project:



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706590/_/"][/dynamiclink]

Fluffy Kitchen Saga Run a cozy restaurant at the bottom of your screen! Staff and customers are all fluffy animals who’ll keep you company while you work or study. Manage your diner filled with fluffballs!

notes.title: Our new studio release - "Whisker Wanderlust" is now available on the store page
notes.notes:
Our studio's healing thick-painted hand-drawn hidden object solo game, "Whisker Wanderlust," has officially announced its store page today~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403446/faed2e618e342ca019c2d727be1a4cd1d3d0b5c7.jpg

Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603580/_/

Game Introduction:
✦ Gameplay Features ✦
Main Quest: Advance the main storyline and obtain the game's final ending by collecting yarn balls hidden across environments.
Commissioned Quests: Interact with NPCs within different scenes to unlock side quests and help them gather more items.
Hidden Level: Unlock Postcard Mode by collecting canned food during the main story progression, then gather Cat Collars from treasure chests in this mode to access bonus challenges and uncover hidden storylines! (Psst... exclusive secret narrative included!)
Artistic Discovery: Explore richly textured painterly landscapes filled with classic IP-inspired Easter eggs and visual surprises.
Each level is a whimsical adventure through fantastical storybook worlds. Our signature thick-painted hand-drawn art style makes every frame wallpaper-worthy – a true visual hallmark of the game. Complemented by custom-crafted background music for each environment, this creates an immersive atmosphere that fully draws you into the experience.
